subject: Request: partial-month invoice & credit for mid-cycle capacity increase
messages:
From: Liam O'Reilly <liam.oreilly@novafirm.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@novafirm.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: partial-month invoice & credit for mid-cycle capacity increase

Hi Jordan,

Quick one from procurement/accounts payable — we went live with the additional dedicated capacity on Feb 4 (PO attached: Novafirm_PO_4782.pdf) and realized the billing for Feb will show the full-month charge rather than a prorated charge for the 4–28 window. Can Redwood either: 1) reissue the Feb invoice with a pro-rated charge for the increased capacity and VAT applied by line, or 2) issue a credit memo for the pro-rated amount to be applied against the March invoice.

A couple of constraints:
- We need a revised invoice for our auditors showing the correct net/VAT split.
- Novafirm's VAT ID is IE9876543F (EU subsidiary billing; please show VAT numbers on the invoice).
- PO# 4782 matches the amendment.

Could you confirm which option works better for Redwood ops and an ETA? We prefer solution (2) if it's faster, but either is fine as long as our accounting team receives a formal document.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Reilly
Procurement Lead, Novafirm, Inc.
liam.oreilly@novafirm.com
attachments: Novafirm_PO_4782.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: partial-month invoice & credit for mid-cycle capacity increase

Thanks Liam — appreciate the heads up and the PO. Looping in Vanessa from Billing and Stephanie (your AM) so we can get this handled quickly.

A couple quick clarifying questions so we calculate correctly:
- Effective increase date: you mentioned Feb 4; can you confirm that is the timestamp we should use for prorating?
- Is the increase purely capacity (GPU units/reserved slots) or are there add-on seats as well?
- For the revised invoice: do you need the reissued Feb invoice to replace the original (historical) invoice, or is a credit memo + a revised copy acceptable for your auditors?
- Confirm VAT ID: IE9876543F and the billing address for Novafirm EU entity.

Plan: Vanessa will run a proration calc (we typically calculate by day, pro-rata by the number of billed units for the mid-cycle window). If you prefer a credit memo applied to next invoice, we can do that same-day once the calc is approved.

Vanessa — can you prepare a CSV breakdown and proposed credit memo amount?

Jordan Blake
Director, Customer Success (billing escalations)
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Reilly <liam.oreilly@novafirm.com>, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: partial-month invoice & credit for mid-cycle capacity increase

Hi Liam / Jordan — attached is our proration_calc_20260211.csv with the line-item breakdown. Summary below:

Summary calculation (for reference):
- Baseline capacity through Feb 3: 4 GPUs at $1,200/mo each = $4,800 monthly
- Increased capacity starting Feb 4: +2 GPUs at $1,200/mo each = +$2,400 monthly
- Prorated window: Feb 4–28 = 25 days out of 28 (we use days in billing month)
- Pro-rated charge for additional capacity for Feb = ($2,400 * 25/28) = $2,142.86
- Tax/VAT: As requested, we split net and VAT lines. Using the EU VAT handling you specified, VAT is shown by line and totals are appended. In our calc file we show VAT at 20% for the EU entity which yields VAT = $428.57.
- Proposed action: issue a credit memo for the difference between original full-month charge and the prorated amount (credit = $257.14 net, VAT adjusted), and apply the credit to the March invoice. Then we will provide a revised Feb invoice (for audit) that reflects the prorated charge and VAT line items.

Questions for Novafirm to confirm:
1) Please confirm the VAT rate to apply (we used 20% as a placeholder).
2) Confirm you'd like the credit applied to March invoice (we can alternatively reissue Feb invoice and void the original).
3) Bank wiring instructions or AP contact for when we issue any refunds (if refund is required instead of credit).

I attached proration_calc_20260211.csv and a sample credit memo template. Once we get confirmation on VAT rate and the credit vs reissue preference, we can finalize and issue docs. ETA for docs: same business day after confirmation.

Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
attachments: proration_calc_20260211.csv

From: Liam O'Reilly <liam.oreilly@novafirm.com>

Thanks Vanessa — that calc looks right. Confirming:
- Effective date Feb 4 is correct.
- Increase was +2 GPUs (capacity only).
- VAT rate is 20% for our EU entity; VAT ID is IE9876543F.
- We prefer the credit memo (apply to March invoice) but still need a revised Feb invoice (non-netting) for audit records that shows the prorated line and VAT breakdown.

Procurement updated the PO to reflect the amendment; attached signed_capacity_amendment.pdf for your records. For refunds, we do not need a bank refund — apply as credit. AP contact: accounts-payable@novafirm.com.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Liam

- Reissue the Feb 2026 invoice as "Revised Invoice" (INV-20260204-R1) that shows the prorated capacity line and a VAT line for your records. We will attach the revised PDF to the AP distribution and to your Drive link.
- Expected timeline: credit memo and revised invoice will be created and emailed by end of business Feb 17 (tomorrow).
- No refund payment will be issued; credit will appear on the March statement. If AP later needs a refund instead, open ticket BILL-3421 and Vanessa will coordinate the wire.
